backup.production_rule: One expense ledger (D-405, Lloyd 2026-11-23): inventory_purchases.transaction_id (FK, on delete set null) and .expense_group; transactions_source_check gains 'inventory'; a BEFORE INSERT trigger (s134_stock_expense_group) and a deferred constraint trigger (s134_stock_expense_sync) turn stock bought into ONE ledger row per receipt without ever failing a stock write; kpi_tab_v1 gets one anchored replace inside if v_fin (md5 80efd89e to 7c6d5a22); 5 client RPCs (authenticated only) plus admin_review_transaction_v1 (s89 body, same signature and grants; approve refuses amount_incomplete / amount_locked / system_category / locked as answers), 2 Telegram RPCs (service_role only), 15 internal functions (no grants); the expense-receipts mime list gains application/pdf (NULL stays NULL, a size limit under 5 MB stops the migration). The migration writes no ledger row: old stock is the back-fill's (supabase/sql/s134_backfill.sql, run only after Lloyd has seen the preview).
backup.notes: Apply after s133 is applied. Restamp restore_point and verified_at with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs; the checker refuses one older than an hour). The Admin and Staff pushes and the Telegram edge functions follow the SQL; the back-fill is a separate, approved step.

forward_verification.name: invariant_one_live_ledger_row_per_receipt_group
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from (select p.expense_group grp, t.id from public.inventory_purchases p join public.transactions t on t.id = p.transaction_id and t.status <> 'void' where p.expense_group is not null union select p.expense_group, t.id from public.inventory_purchases p join public.transactions t on t.external_ref = 'stock:' || p.expense_group and t.status <> 'void' where p.expense_group is not null) l group by grp having count(distinct id) > 1) and not exists (select 1 from (select p.expense_group grp, min(p.created_at) first_at, (bool_or(p.unit_cost > 0) or exists (select 1 from public.inventory_receipt_drafts d where p.expense_group = 'draft:' || d.id::text and d.total > 0)) priced from public.inventory_purchases p where p.expense_group is not null group by p.expense_group) g where g.priced and g.first_at >= (select (s.value #>> '{}')::timestamptz from public.app_settings s where s.key = 's134_stock_expense_from') and not exists (select 1 from (select p.expense_group grp, t.id from public.inventory_purchases p join public.transactions t on t.id = p.transaction_id and t.status <> 'void' where p.expense_group is not null union select p.expense_group, t.id from public.inventory_purchases p join public.transactions t on t.external_ref = 'stock:' || p.expense_group and t.status <> 'void' where p.expense_group is not null) l where l.grp = g.grp) and not exists (select 1 from public.inventory_purchases p2 join public.transactions v on (v.id = p2.transaction_id or v.external_ref = 'stock:' || p2.expense_group) and v.status = 'void' and coalesce(v.notes, '') not like '%[voided: stock receipt%' where p2.expense_group = g.grp))

accepted_failing_tests.note: Baseline of a --no-acl restore of the production backup (DATA: the copy lacks the rows the suite expects; ACL: the copy lacks the grants). Each fails identically on a scratch DB without s134. Any failure outside these numbers stops the release.

s110_kpi_supply_laundry.note: Measured on backup cascade-supabase-20261123T120703Z, full TAP in .s134/s110-base.tap (no s134) and .s134/s110-s134.tap (s134 applied): both runs print ok 118 of 147, not ok 12, psql errors 41, byte-identical not-ok lists. 39,47-51,58,59,63,64 = data the copy lacks (rate list and meter readings); 128,129 = grants the --no-acl copy lacks (service_role on inventory_receipt_drafts and the matcher function). The first psql error is at suite line 380, permission denied for table inventory_receipt_drafts (the service_role insert), which aborts the suite transaction: tests 131-147 then never run and the other 40 psql errors are 'current transaction is aborted'. With that one grant replayed on the copy (rehearsal copy only) the suite runs all 147 with 0 errors and the same 10 data failures plus 129 in both runs (.s134/s110-base-granted.tap, .s134/s110-s134-granted.tap).

s89_admin_hub.note: Measured on backup cascade-supabase-20261123T120703Z: 60 of 62 ok, not ok 2 (anon and PUBLIC cannot execute) and 62 (anon is refused outright) with s134 applied (.s134/s89-s134.tap) and with s134 rolled back (.s134/s89-base.tap): identical; the --no-acl copy lacks the grants these two assert.

rollback.safe_until: Any time, losing nothing: the rollback drops the two triggers, every s134 function and the three indexes, puts kpi_tab_v1 back to the s127 body (md5 pinned), and KEEPS the cut-over setting s134_stock_expense_from (re-applying keeps the earliest value, so the cut-over date never moves). It also KEEPS the 'inventory' value in the source CHECK, the two purchase columns, the guest_refund category, application/pdf in the bucket list and every ledger row already written, so it is safe with inventory rows present (rehearsed).
